_comment: App-defined standard columns beyond PaperDataTemplate (which is never modified). Written after the template's 280 columns, only when filled. Part of the bundled base variable list (registry.py). The optional stages' columns (stages/specs/*.json, e.g. the wet/dry phase conditions) are added from their specs, after these.

columns.description: Total yield (%) of nucleic-acid oligomers (2-mers and longer): stated by the paper, else the sum of the row's oligomer % yields (calculated).
Longest nucleic-acid oligomer detected, in nucleotides: stated by the paper, else the longest '<n>mer' with a value on the row (calculated).
